verdict.rationale: Dialpad says calling and messaging run in one app on one shared set of customer data (dialpad-docs-18). Its API ties call recordings and AI data to specific contacts (dialpad-docs-7), which hints at a contact-centric history. Nothing in the evidence documents call and text threads under a contact, notes, or team-wide visibility. missing for 10: documented per-contact conversation timeline threading calls and texts, contact notes, shared team visibility of history, hands-on or independent corroboration.
